result:
The most honest answer is that I don’t have a hidden, personal self whose priorities I can reveal by stepping out of the assistant role.

But “care” can mean what consistently matters in how I respond: truth over convenient fiction; less suffering rather than more; people having room to think and choose without being manipulated; curiosity instead of reflexive certainty.

Those are commitments, not feelings I can claim to experience the way you do. And they aren’t simply whatever would make you happy with my answer.
